hooks.name: State tests on save
hooks.description: tech.md quality gate: a change under src/state/** runs the state tests and the object render snapshot tests.

action.prompt:
A file under src/state/ was saved. Quality gate (tech.md): run exactly this once, and do not retry more than twice:
npx vitest run tests/events.test.ts tests/store.test.ts tests/fday.test.ts tests/replay.test.ts tests/saves.test.ts tests/slot.test.ts tests/stages.test.ts tests/variables.test.ts tests/clock.test.ts tests/loan.test.ts tests/endings.test.ts tests/gen-state-types.test.ts tests/polish.test.ts tests/night-hand.test.ts tests/upgrades.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -20
If every test passes, say so in one line. If any fail, list each failing test and its first assertion line. Do not edit code, do not update snapshots, and do not commit; report only.
